Private Feedback: privacy and retention

Approved November 14, 2026.

What we collect and why

When you send private Feedback, we store your conversation category, subject, messages and replies, timestamps, status, read markers, and your account identifier. We also keep limited records of status changes, retries and request limits to operate the inbox, prevent duplicate messages and protect the service. We do not copy your food preferences or other profile answers into Feedback records.

Who can read it

Your conversations are private between your account and authorized EZEATS Owners. Owner replies appear as “EZEATS Team.” Other users and recipe contributors cannot read your conversations. Clerk verifies sign-in; Neon stores the records; Vercel hosts the inbox and its server functions. Authorized personnel and these service providers may process information needed to operate, secure and recover the service. Private does not mean inaccessible to the service operator or its providers.

What not to send

Please don’t include passwords, payment information, or other sensitive personal information. Feedback accepts plain text only, without attachments. Text that resembles a website address is not made into a clickable link. Feedback is not an emergency service; replies are not guaranteed within a particular time. This version uses in-app unread indicators only, with no email, SMS, push notifications or AI-generated replies.

Retention and archiving

Open conversations are retained while needed to address the issue. Owners review inactive open conversations after 12 months to decide whether to close, archive, minimize or delete them. Closed or archived conversations are reviewed for deletion or anonymization within 90 days, unless an active support issue, abuse investigation, legal obligation or documented dispute requires longer retention. A reopened conversation may remain available while the issue is active.

Archiving hides a conversation from the active Owner queue and makes it read-only; it does not erase the messages. These periods are manual review deadlines, not automatic deletion promises. Any longer retention must have a recorded reason and a new review date.

Operational records and backups

Rate-limit records are reviewed for removal after 30 days. Retry-protection records are retained while their conversation remains so old retries cannot create duplicate messages; they are removed when that conversation is deleted. Private moderation audit records are reviewed for minimization after 12 months unless required for an active investigation or documented dispute. Routine application logs exclude message bodies, subjects, account identifiers and authentication tokens.

Deleting active records does not immediately remove database recovery copies or backups. Their retention follows the configured provider recovery settings and any separately retained recovery branches. Recovery copies are restricted to operational recovery. After a restore, recorded deletion decisions must be reapplied before normal use resumes.

Access, correction and deletion requests

Contact ezeats44@gmail.com to request access, correction or deletion. We verify account ownership before disclosing or changing private information. Owners review a verified deletion request within 30 days and communicate any documented reason for longer retention. This is a review deadline, not a promise that every backup copy will be erased within 30 days.

Deleting your sign-in account does not automatically delete Feedback conversations. Owners reconcile account-deletion requests, review associated messages and account links, and delete or anonymize them under the same process. Do not send passwords or identity documents in a Feedback message to verify a request.
